purpose: Teach: 出撃/前途/可否/押え/広義/互角/前段/奔走

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、創業時、敢えて市場へ出撃された
lines.en: Your father — when he founded the company, he made a bold move into the market.
lines.style: Measured, almost ceremonial. Pause weight between clauses. Voice carries deep admiration tempered by age. Speaking as though placing a memory carefully on the table.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは社員の前途を信じておられた
lines.en: Yes. Father trusted his employees' futures completely.
lines.style: Quietly certain. Not defensive — this is fact laid down. Soft gravity on 「信じておられた」. Voice steady, grounded in witnessing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、難案件の可否を即断された
lines.en: Your father — he made difficult decisions instantly. Never wavered.
lines.style: Slower cadence. Each phrase deliberate, like turning over something precious. Slight weariness underneath — the weight of remembering decisiveness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは経費を押え込んで再投資された
lines.en: Yes. Father kept costs tight and poured everything back into growth.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact respect. No flourish. The tone of someone who inherited a principle and lives it. Pause before 「再投資」 — acknowledging its importance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、広義の業界動向にも目配りされてた
lines.en: Your father — he kept his eyes on the whole industry landscape.
lines.style: Softer now, almost marveling. Slight trailing quality — 'how did he manage it all?' Breath visible in the pauses between thoughts.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは大手と互角に勝負された
lines.en: Yes. Father competed with the biggest names as equals.
lines.style: Voice carries quiet pride without arrogance. Firm on the fact itself. Brief, not because he's rushed but because the truth needs no embellishment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お父さん、講演の前段で謙虚さを示された
lines.en: Your father — even before he gave talks, he showed humility.
lines.style: Contemplative, almost philosophical. Voice drops slightly. This was the thing — not the success, but the character underneath. Trailing off suggests deep knowing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。お父さんは創業期、毎日奔走された
lines.en: Yes. In those early days, Father was everywhere at once — tireless.
lines.style: Finality and warmth. This is the closing piece. Voice settles on a note of gratitude and understanding. Calm, certain, like coming to rest.
